correctness.rationale: The contour bijection gives H=n+A and D=primitive-component count. A three-variable formal power series supplies exact area, degree, and mixed moments; their coefficients yield the claimed formula. The ratio b_(n+1)/b_n minus t_(n+1)/t_n is a positive explicit fraction, proving strict negativity for every integer n>=2. Exact verifier passes 760 assertions; this supports but does not substitute the all-size proof.
